zh: 新增邮箱验证码登录；GitHub 登录一步直达授权页，失败提示更明确
个人中心重构为统一账户中心：可查看 AI 用量与额度重置时间；邮箱账号可关联 GitHub，解锁 star、关注等需要 GitHub 身份的功能
收藏支持云端同步，换设备或重装后自动恢复
AI 对话支持多会话切换、联网搜索（回答附来源），新增 Deep Research 深度研究模式
AI 回答的代码高亮与表格排版升级，阅读更清晰
主题配色重做，支持自定义主题色与配色历史
Product Hunt 条目点击/分享/收藏直达原帖；分享按钮独立展示；修复每日提醒不准时、额度重置倒计时不刷新
en: New email verification code sign-in; GitHub sign-in goes straight to the authorization page, with clearer error messages

Profile rebuilt into a unified account center: check your AI usage and when the quota resets; email accounts can now link a GitHub account to unlock starring, following, and other GitHub-backed features
Favorites now sync to the cloud and restore automatically after switching devices or reinstalling
AI chat supports multiple sessions and web search (answers include sources), plus a new Deep Research mode
Upgraded code highlighting and table layout in AI answers for easier reading
Reworked theme colors, with custom accent colors and a color history

Product Hunt items link directly to the original post for view, share, and favorite; share button now shown directly on cards; fixed daily reminder timing drift and a quota reset countdown that never refreshed
